annotations.title: Place a thing or a plant

description: Place furniture or a plant: something from storage comes back free; anything else is bought with coins (check catalog and check plants list them, with a good spot for each plant). spot is where, in tiles: "6 10", optionally with facing west. Call check (what: storage) to see what you have and check (what: catalog) for what can be bought before placing.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

spot.description: Optional: where, like 6 10, or 6 10 facing west.

name: place
